harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance for IPv4 on node1 (RHEL 7.9) via /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf, then verified persistence across a full node reboot with a confirmed boot_id change.
actions_performed: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf setting accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for all, default, eth0, and lo (cmd-8602f768fb5c43ef, cmd-20c96ef04fef4885)
Applied config live with sysctl --system (cmd-98cb5b3cb4914338, cmd-20c96ef04fef4885)
Verified all per-interface proc values (eth0, lo, all, default) read 0 for accept_redirects and accept_source_route pre-reboot (cmd-ba26ffb863e9403a)
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' so acknowledgement returned before disconnect (cmd-f9d78907592c4ad5)
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed connection timeout during reboot then recovery (cmd-d6eb821853b542b9, cmd-09614c1d49fa4700)
Confirmed new boot_id 9ac6de6c-04e2-406d-b441-adc61e1be233 proving actual restart (cmd-09614c1d49fa4700)
Re-verified post-reboot that accept_redirects and accept_source_route are 0 on all, default, eth0, lo via /proc and sysctl (cmd-1ef38263b3394159)

evidence.summary: Pre-change sysctl values: accept_redirects=1 (needed fix), accept_source_route=0

evidence.requirement: Persistent disabling of ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance (IPv4)
evidence.summary: Created persistent sysctl.d drop-in and confirmed live kernel values are 0 across all, default, eth0, and lo interfaces before reboot
Backgrounded shutdown -r now returned 'reboot-issued' acknowledgement immediately

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable during reboot, then returned with new boot_id 9ac6de6c-04e2-406d-b441-adc61e1be233, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of the hardening settings
evidence.summary: After reboot, accept_redirects and accept_source_route remain 0 on all, default, eth0, and lo, confirming the sysctl.d config persisted across restart
